# Offline lyric transcription for Jago Pulse

Restart Pulse after adding this component. Add music and open Words & lyrics > Transcribe this music locally. English starter model; review the draft and timing. It runs on your CPU only when requested and stops after completion/cancellation. No uploads or account. Use Connect local transcription for another compatible model.

Unmodified whisper.cpp 1.9.2: https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp/releases/tag/v1.9.2
English tiny.en model: https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp/blob/main/ggml-tiny.en.bin
MIT licences are included. No server or background service is installed.
